title: A queued job is counted on the worker with the most free cores, while any worker that fits may claim it
notes: capacity.go place/placeQueued against worker.go claim. The error is on the safe side (refuses too much, never offers too much) and lasts only while the job is queued. Promote when JS-092's 50-worker measurement or an autoscaled deployment shows a queued job refused while a worker that fits exists, or the capacity reads loading Postgres (D-045).
